cross_references.source_quote: Reinforcement shall have concrete cover and the thickness of such cover shall be as specified in the Drawings or as directed by the ER.
Grading of coarse aggregate shall conform to the requirements in IS 383.
Grading of fine aggregate shall conform to IS 383 and shall fall within limits of one of the four zones given in table 4 of IS 383.

The maximum quantities of deleterious materials in the coarse aggregate when determined in accordance with IS 2386 Part I and Part II "Method of test for aggregates for concrete' shall not exceed the limits provided in Table -- 8.

source_quotes.cement_type: Cement shall be ordinary Portland cement conforming to IS 369 for all purpose unless specified differently.

source_quotes.specified_wc: The water cement ratio shall be between 0.5 to 0.52.
source_quotes.mixing_time_minutes: The mixer shall be run for a minimum period of 2 minutes after all materials are loaded in full quantity.
source_quotes.transport_time_minutes: Concrete shall be placed in position within 30 minutes from the time it is produced.
source_quotes.compaction_method: Concrete shall be thoroughly compacted, as depositing shall proceed by means of suitable vibrators.
source_quotes.curing_days:
Starting 24 hours after placement of the concrete, the surface shall be cured by flooding with water or covering with damp Hessian cloth for a period of 7 days to keep it moist.
For the next 7 days the surface shall be kept wet all the time by sprinkling water continuously.
source_quotes.specified_slump_mm: The slump shall be 25 mm to 35 mm depending upon the location and type of Work.
source_quotes.water_ph: The PH value of water shall not be less than 6 and more than11.

remarks.specified_wc: Clause 3.6 B.1.d specifies water-cement ratio between 0.5 to 0.52, whereas Table 5 sets the maximum water-cement ratio for Moderate reinforced concrete at 0.60.
remarks.transport_time_minutes: Clause 3.6 F.6 specifies placing within 30 minutes, whereas Clause 1.7 A.3 notes a general mixing/delivery time of 1-1/2 hrs reducible to 1-1/4 hrs in hot weather.
remarks.curing_days: Total curing time of 14 days consists of 7 days moist curing under damp Hessian cloth followed by 7 days of continuous water sprinkling.
remarks.sampling_frequency: The sampling frequency table appears twice in the document (clauses 3.8.I.5 and 3.10.E.2.a); the complete version in 3.10.E.2.a was extracted.
